comment: Input index 2 is SOURCELVL_INPUT, declared but never given a widget, so it cannot be clicked and gets no line, no tag and no props. The PAN CV range is given as ±5V because that is the middle of the three the menu offers; the jack covers 0-10V or ±10V under the other two settings. The bar display and the BPM and meter displays are custom widgets with no ParamWidget, so the track menu they carry cannot be reached by clicking them for help; the same items are on the module's own menu under Track settings. Unlike sickoLooper3 and 5 this module has no SOLO button, no MASTER or EAR outputs and no preset files, and it adds V/Oct, PAN CV, VOL CV and a triggerable REV input.
